dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: Just as I always say, the days will definitely get better.

dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: The Shogun's Army treats us pretty well... It's just that we workers used to be in charge in the mines. Here, we need to listen to the soldiers.

dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: It's not all bad, though. At least we have a place to stay. We just have to wait out the war...
